text: After resolution/retention, canonical type keys and function keys shall be sorted by unsigned UTF-8 bytes of canonical JSON and assigned IDs from one. Continuation triples shall use that ordering; global canonical keys shall receive IDs from 16 with monitor 1 reserved. IDs shall not be stable source constants.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
